strategies.name: trend_reversal_to_higher_timeframe_continuation
strategies.entry_summary: Use the higher timeframe (4-hour/1-hour) trend bias, then on the 15-minute or 5-minute chart wait for the pullback downtrend to stop making lower lows and then break above the most recent lower high. Enter on that bullish structure break in the direction of the higher-timeframe trend.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss under the low/level that should not break if the bullish reversal is valid. Target the next higher-timeframe high (such as the 1-hour high), with the possibility of holding further if the broader trend continues.

consensus.enumeration_note: The transcript teaches one core strategy: trade with higher-timeframe trend by entering when lower-timeframe bearish pullback flips bullish; the 15-minute and 5-minute examples are compatible variants, not distinct strategies. The final 1-minute 'small scalp' mention is not promoted because it lacks a runnable exit rule.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: you know the 4 hour and the one hour is bullish, all you're doing is waiting for that 15minut time frame or 5 minute time frame
entry_sequence.action: Use the 4-hour and 1-hour charts as bullish higher-timeframe bias before looking for an entry on the 15-minute or 5-minute chart.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker says the lower-timeframe trigger should align with the bullish 4-hour and 1-hour trend.

entry_sequence.action: On the pullback timeframe, wait for price to stop making lower lows.
entry_sequence.rationale: Failure to print another lower low is the first sign the bearish pullback may be ending.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: the second thing that confirms that would be price breaking above that lower high
entry_sequence.action: Wait for price to break above the most recent lower high to confirm the pullback has turned bullish.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker uses the break of the lower high as confirmation that structure has shifted bullish.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: all you're doing is waiting for price to go back bullish on that 15minut time frame
entry_sequence.action: Enter long when the 15-minute or 5-minute chart turns back bullish in the direction of the higher-timeframe trend.
entry_sequence.rationale: The entry is the lower-timeframe bullish structure break aligned with higher-timeframe continuation.

stop.transcript_quote: putting your stop loss under that level where you don't want to see price get broken
stop.rationale: The speaker says to place the stop under the level that should not break if the bullish reversal is valid.

targets.transcript_quote: Once you scale back out to that 1 hour time frame, you'll target that 1 hour high.
targets.rationale: The speaker says the target is the 1-hour high after entry.
